S.R. D-2342

SHANGAI MUNICIPAL
C. & S. I. R.
No. S. D. D. 2342.
ate 20 - 6 - 31.

June 19 31.

My dear Blackburn,

With reference to your letter of June 13,
I have to state that a new tribunal called "The
Shanghai Provisional Military and Judicial Joint
Hearing Court" (上海市臨時軍法會審) has been
functioning since May 19, 1931, at the Woosung-Shanghai
Garrison Commander's Headquarters, Lunghua. The
principal duty of the new tribunal is to undertake
the investigation and trial of important Communistic
and reactionary cases.

The authority for the formation of the Shanghai
Provisional Military and Judicial Joint Hearing Court
was contained in an order issued in May by the Nationalist
Government.

The arrangements for the establishment of the
new Court, which included the drawing up of regulations
governing its functions, were made by a committee consis-
ting of representatives of the Shanghai Special District
Kuomintang, the Municipality of Greater Shanghai, the
Woosung-Shanghai Garrison Commander's Headquarters and
the Kiangsu High Court. The present judges of the
Court consist of :
Chief Judge Chen Han Chu (陳漢佐), former Judge of the
Military Court of the Woosung-Shanghai Garrison
Commander's Headquarters.

工部局

日期 1931年6月20日。

1931年6月19日。

亲爱的布莱克本：

关于您6月13日的来信，兹声明一个名为“上海市临时军法会审”（上海市臨時軍法會審）的新法庭自1931年5月19日起在龙华吴淞上海警备司令部总部开始运作。该新法庭的主要职责是负责调查和审判重要的共产主义及反动案件。

成立上海市临时军法会审的授权依据包含在国民政府于5月发布的一项命令中。

新法庭的设立安排，包括起草规范其职能的章程，是由一个委员会负责的，该委员会由国民党上海特别区党部、大上海市政府、吴淞上海警备司令部总部以及江苏高等法院的代表组成。目前该法庭的法官包括：
首席法官陈汉佐（陳漢佐），原吴淞上海警备司令部总部军法处法官。

Judge Tai Yuen Chuan(戴遠傳), former Judge of the
Military Court of the Woosung-Shanghai Garrison
Commander's Headquarters.
(The above were nominated by the Woosung-Shanghai
Garrison Commander's Headquarters).
Judge Chien Chen Chun(錢承鈞), Judge of the Soochow
High Court.
(Nominated by the Kiangsu High Court).
Judge Huang Tou Ling(黃道霖), Chief of the 3rd
Department of the Public Safety Bureau,
Municipality of Greater Shanghai.
(Nominated by the Municipality of Greater Shanghai)
Judge Chiang Hua Su(姜懷素 ), Member of the Committee
of the Local Kuomintang Headquarters.
(Nominated by the Shanghai District Kuomintang)

The formal inauguration of the Shanghai Provisional
Military and Judicial Joint Hearing Court took place at
Lunghua at the headquarters of the Garrison Commander
on May 19, 1931, when the above mentioned judges
officially assumed office.

The Court commenced to function on May 29 and
will sit every Tuesday and Friday. No information has
so far been given out about the cases with which it has
dealt, and it is difficult to learn anything about them
because the public is excluded from its sittings and
persons brought before it for trial are not allowed to
engage lawyers.

In order to enable you to get a clear idea of the
manner in which the Shanghai Provisional Military and
Judicial Joint Hearing Court functions, I attach herewith
translations of the regulations of the Court which appeared
in the Chinese Press on May 21,1931.

Yours sincerely,

Encl:- 2.

A.D. Blackburn, Esq.,
H.B.M. Consulate-General.

上海市临时军法会审的正式启动仪式于1931年5月19日在龙华警备司令总部举行，届时上述法官正式就职。

该法庭于5月29日开始运作，每周二和周五开庭。迄今为止，尚未公布其审理案件的任何信息，且由于公众被禁止旁听庭审，受审人员也不允许聘请律师，因此很难了解到相关情况。

为了使您对上海市临时军法会审的运作方式有一个清晰的了解，随函附上1931年5月21日刊登在中文报刊上的该法庭章程译文。

page_data.en:
Regulations governing the Formation of the Shanghai
Provisional Military and Judicial Joint Hearing Court.

(Published in the China Times and other local
newspapers on May 21).

Article 1. The Shanghai Provisional Military and
Judicial Joint Hearing Court will be organised by
officials appointed by the undermentioned organs:-
(1) The Shanghai Special District Kuomintang;
(2) The Municipality of Greater Shanghai;
(3) The Kiangsu High Court; and
(4) The Woosung-Shanghai Garrison Commissioner's Headquarters.
The organ mentioned at item No. 1 (the Shanghai Special
District Kuomintang) may not detail any official to
participate in the organisation of this Court.
Article 2. The Shanghai Provisional Military and
Judicial Joint Hearing Court will hear all communistic
cases of an important nature. Cases arising in areas
wherein martial law is in force or wherein bandit
suppression forces are functioning as stipulated in
Article 7 of the Emergency Penalty Law for Endangering
the Republic after its enforcement, are not within the
jurisdiction of this Court.
Article 3. The organ mentioned at item No. 4 of
Article 1 (The Woosung-Shanghai Garrison Commissioner's
Headquarters) will appoint two officials, while the
organs mentioned in other items will each appoint one
official to act as Judges of the Shanghai Provisional
Military and Judicial Joint Hearing Court and these
deputies will elect from among themselves the Chief
Judge. If the total number of Judges appointed by the
aforementioned organs is an even one, the Kiangsu
High Court may appoint an extra Judge.
Article 4. The Shanghai Provisional Military and
Judicial Joint Hearing Court will engage one secretary-
in-chief and a number of assistant secretaries. These
positions may be filled from the staffs of the various
organs mentioned in Article 1, but extra clerks may be
employed.
Article 5. The official seal of the Shanghai Pro-
visional Military and Judicial Joint Hearing Court will
be issued by the Woosung-Shanghai Garrison Commissioner's
Headquarters.
Article 6. The funds for the Shanghai Provisional
Military and Judicial Joint Hearing Court will be provided
by the Woosung-Shanghai Garrison Commissioner's Head-
quarters and the Municipality of Greater Shanghai.
Article 7. The Regulations governing Trials by
the Shanghai Provisional Military and Judicial Joint
Hearing Court will be issued separately.
Article 8. The detailed rules governing the functioning
of the Shanghai Provisional Military and Judicial Joint
Hearing Court will be drawn up by the Woosung-Shanghai
Garrison Commissioner's Headquarters in conjunction with
the Municipality of Greater Shanghai and will be submitted
to the Administrative Council and the Judicial Council
for approval.
Article 9. These regulations will come into force from
the date of their approval by the National Government.

上海市临时军法会审组织章程。

（5月21日刊登于《字林西报》及其他本地报纸）。

第一条 上海市临时军法会审由下列机关指派官员组成：
(1) 国民党上海特别区党部；
(2) 大上海市政府；
(3) 江苏高等法院；以及
(4) 吴淞上海警备司令部总部。
第一条第(1)项所述机关（国民党上海特别区党部）不得派遣任何官员参与本法庭的组织工作。
第二条 上海市临时军法会审将审理所有性质重要的共产主义案件。在戒严令生效区域或根据《危害民国紧急治罪法》第七条规定有剿匪部队运作的区域内发生的案件，不在本法庭管辖范围之内。
第三条 第一条第(4)项所述机关（吴淞上海警备司令部总部）将指派两名官员，其他各项所述机关将各指派一名官员担任上海市临时军法会审法官，这些法官将从他们之中选举产生首席法官。如果上述机关指派的法官总数为偶数，江苏高等法院可增派一名法官。
第四条 上海市临时军法会审将聘用主任书记官一名及助理书记官若干名。这些职位可由第一条所述各机关的工作人员充任，但也可额外雇用书记员。
第五条 上海市临时军法会审的官方印章将由吴淞上海警备司令部总部颁发。
第六条 上海市临时军法会审的经费将由吴淞上海警备司令部总部和大上海市政府提供。
第七条 上海市临时军法会审审判章程将另行颁布。
第八条 上海市临时军法会审运作细则将由吴淞上海警备司令部总部会同大上海市政府制定，并提交行政会议和司法会议批准。
第九条 本章程自国民政府批准之日起生效。

Regulations governing Trials in the Shanghai Pro-
visional Military and Judicial Joint Hearing Court.

(Published in the Shun Pao and other local
Chinese newspapers on May 21)

Article 1. These regulations are stipulated in
accordance with Article 7 of "The General Principles
of Organization of Provisional Joint Hearing Courts of
Military and Judicial Authorities of Various Provinces".
Article 2. In the Shanghai Provisional Military and
Judicial Joint Hearing Court, trials are to be held by
the Judges sitting jointly and no trial is to be held
without more than half of the judges being present.
Article 3. In the Shanghai Provisional Military and
Judicial Joint Hearing Court, the legal defence system
(?defence by lawyers) is not to be enforced.
Article 4. Trials by the Shanghai Provisional Military
and Judicial Joint Hearing Court may not be conducted
publicly.
Article 5. Before the hearing of a case, the Chief
Judge may designate a judge to conduct an investigation
with a view to obtaining evidence. When the investigation
has been completed or when the facts of the case are
so clear that an investigation is considered unnecessary,
the investigating judge shall then request the Chief Judge to
hold a joint hearing.
Article 6. Cases found to be beyond the jurisdiction
of the Court should be referred to the official organs
concerned for trial. However, if a defendant is charged
with several offences one of which comes under the
jurisdiction of the Court, he is to be tried on all the
charges in accordance with the respective laws governing each
charge.
Article 7. The Chief Judge and the Investigating
Judge may issue summonses against defendants, witnesses or
complainants; warrants against defendants or witnesses;
detention certificates against defendants; and search
warrants.
Article 8. The Chief Judge is to question defendants
and others, but the attendant Judges may put questions
with the approval of the Chief Judge.
Article 9. At the commencement of a trial, questions
are to be put regarding the name, age, nativity, address,
and occupation of the defendant in order to ascertain that
he is the right person to be charged.
Article 10. Defendants are to be questioned separately,
but if it is absolutely necessary the defendants, witnesses,
or complainants are to be ordered to confront one another.
Article 11. The defendant is to be carefully questioned
regarding all the accusations made against him. If he
denies the charge, he is to be ordered to furnish proof
of his innocence.
Article 12. Before questioning, witnesses or complainants
are to be warned against making false statements and told
that they are liable to punishment if they are found to
have given false evidence. They are ordered to sign a bond.

上海市临时军法会审审判章程。

（5月21日刊登于《申报》及其他本地中文报纸）

第一条 本章程系依据《各省临时军法会审组织通则》第七条规定制定。
第二条 在上海市临时军法会审中，审判由法官合议进行，出席法官不足半数时不得开庭审判。
第三条 在上海市临时军法会审中，不实行法律辩护制度（?律师辩护）。
第四条 上海市临时军法会审的审判不得公开进行。
第五条 在案件听证之前，首席法官可指定一名法官进行调查以获取证据。当调查完成或案件事实清楚认为无需调查时，调查法官应请求首席法官举行合议听证。
第六条 发现属于法庭管辖范围之外的案件，应移送有关官方机关审判。但是，如果被告被指控多项罪名，其中一项属于本法庭管辖，则应根据各项罪名各自的适用法律对所有指控进行审判。
第七条 首席法官和调查法官可以对被告、证人或原告发出传票；对被告或证人发出逮捕令；对被告发出拘留证；以及搜查令。
第八条 首席法官负责讯问被告及其他人员，但经首席法官批准，陪席法官也可以提问。
第九条 审判开始时，应就被告的姓名、年龄、籍贯、住址和职业进行提问，以确认其为正确的受指控人。
第十条 被告应分别接受讯问，但如果绝对必要，应命令被告、证人或原告相互对质。
第十一条 应就针对被告的所有指控对其进行仔细讯问。如果其否认指控，应命令其提供无罪证明。
第十二条 在讯问证人或原告之前，应警告其不得作虚假陈述，并告知如果发现其提供伪证，将受到惩罚。并命令其签署具结书。

Article 13. Court records should be clearly
and correctly made by Court clerks and read out to the
persons questioned. If the person concerned states that
a mistake has been made in the record, a correction is
to be made. In the case of the Court record being
correct, the person questioned is to be ordered to sign
his name or affix his finger prints on the record.
Article 14. Articles 9 to 13 are to be applied when
an investigating judge is making enquiries.
Article 15. When the hearing of a case is concluded,
the Chief Judge is to hold a conference of the Judges who
participated in the hearing, before rendering a decision.
They should sign their names in the minute book contain-
ing the particulars of the conference.
Article 16. The decision of the conference of the
Judges, put in writing by the Court Clerk and signed
and sealed by the Chief Judge and the Attendant Judges,
should be submitted to the Headquarters of the Woosung
Shanghai Garrison Commissioner for approval. A report
should be submitted to the Municipality of Greater
Shanghai and a notification by letter should be sent
to the Shanghai Special District Kuomintang and the
Kiangsu Supreme Court for their information.
Article 17. If a case is committed by several
persons who are not all in custody, those already arrested
are to be tried and sentenced regardless of the others.
Article 18. If the Headquarters of the Woosung-
Shanghai Garrison Commissioner regards the decision in a
case doubtful, or mistakes have occurred, it may refer
the case back to the Court for retrial.
Article 19. When the decision of a case is approved
by the Headquarters of the Woosung-Shanghai Garrison
Commissioner, the defendant is to be taken before the
Court when the Court clerk will read out the facts
of the case and the Chief Judge pronounce the sentence.
Article 20. The Chief Judge is to direct the
execution of the sentences. In the case of the death
penalty, the Chief Judge shall appoint an officer to
supervise the execution. No persons, except those with
the permission of the Chief Judge, are to be admitted
to the place of execution.
Article 21. These regulations are to be put into
force after their approval by the National Government.

第十三条 法庭记录应由法庭书记员清晰、准确地制作，并向被讯问人宣读。如果相关人员指出记录中有错误，应予更正。如果法庭记录正确，应命令被讯问人在记录上签名或按指印。
第十四条 调查法官进行问询时，适用第九条至第十三条的规定。
第十五条 案件听证结束后，首席法官应在作出裁决前召集参与听证的法官开会。他们应在记载会议详情的会议记录簿上签名。
第十六条 法官会议的裁决由法庭书记员书面记录，并由首席法官和陪席法官签名盖章后，提交吴淞上海警备司令部总部批准。应向大上海市政府提交报告，并以信函形式通知国民党上海特别区党部和江苏高等法院知悉。
第十七条 如果案件涉及多人，而并非所有人均在押，则应对已逮捕的人员进行审判和判刑，不论其他人如何。
第十八条 如果吴淞上海警备司令部总部认为某案件的裁决存疑或出现错误，可将案件发回法庭重审。
第十九条 当案件裁决获得吴淞上海警备司令部总部批准后，应将被告带至法庭，由法庭书记员宣读案件事实，并由首席法官宣判。
第二十条 首席法官负责指挥判决的执行。在死刑案件中，首席法官应指派一名军官监督执行。除经首席法官许可者外，任何人不得进入行刑地点。
第二十一条 本章程经国民政府批准后施行。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Special Branch S.1. SHACH,
REPORT
Date June 16, 1931

Subject (in full) Provisional Military Court of Shanghai established at
Lunghua

Made by and Forwarded by C.D.I. Robertson

On receipt of an order issued by the National Government
early in May 1931 instructing local Kuomintang, Administrative,
Military and Judicial organs to form a joint provisional
military court for the trial of serious cases against communists
and other re-actionaries, the Shanghai Special District Kuo-
mintang, the Municipality of Greater Shanghai, the Garrison
Commissioner's Headquarters and the Kiangsu High Court, or-
ganized from among their members a preparatory committee which
drew up regulations governing court procedure and formation
of the profused Court. These were sent to the Administrative
Council for approval. As the result of further discussion by
the Preparatory Committee the following members were nominated
by the respective participating members of the Committee to
serve as Judges in the new tribunal.
Chief Judge Chen Han Chu (陳漢佐), Former Judge of the
Woosung-Shanghai Defence Commissioner's Yamen.
Nominated by the Woosung-Shanghai Garrison Commissioner's
Headquarters.
Judge Tai Yuen Chuan (戴遠傳), Former Judge of the Woosung-
Shanghai Defence Commissioner's Yamen. Nominated by
the Woosung-Shanghai Garrison Commissioner's Headquarters.
Judge Chien Chen Chun (錢承鈞), Former Judge of the Soochow
High Court. Nominated by the Soochow High Court
Judge Huang Tou Sung (黃憶生), Chief of the 3rd Department
of the Bureau of Public Safety Shanghai. Nominated by
The Municipality of Greater Shanghai.
Judge Chiang Hua Su (姜懷素), Member of the Committee of
local Kuomintang Headquarters. Nominated by the
Shanghai District Kuomintang.

首席法官陈汉佐（陳漢佐），原吴淞上海防卫司令衙门法官。
由淞沪警备司令部提名。

由淞沪警备司令部提名。

由苏州高等法院提名。

REGULATIONS GOVERNING TRIALS IN THE SHANGHAI PROVISIONAL
MILITARY AND JUDICIAL JOINT HEARING COURT

(published in the Shun Pao and other local newspapers)

Article 1. These regulations are stipulated in accordance
with Article 7 of "The General Principles of Organization of
Provisional Joint Hearing Courts of Military and Judicial
Authorities of Various Provinces."
Article 2. In the Shanghai Provisional Military and
Judicial Joint Hearing Court, trials are to be held by the
judges sitting jointly, and no trial is to be held without
more than half of the judges being present.
Article 3. In the Shanghai Provisional Military and
Judicial Joint Hearing Court, the legal defence system
(? defence by lawyers) is not to be enforced.
Article 4. Trials by the Shanghai Provisional Military
and Judicial Joint Hearing Court may not be conducted publicly.
Article 5. Before the hearing of a case, the Chief Judge
may designate a judge to conduct an investigation with a view
to obtaining evidence, when the investigation has been completed
or, when the fact of the case are so clear that an investigation
is considered unnecessary, the investigating judge shall then
report the Chief Judge to hold a joint hearing.
Article 6. Cases found to be beyond the jurisdiction of
the Court should be referred to the official organs concerned
for trial. Moreover, if a defendant is charged with several
offences one of which comes under the jurisdiction of the Court,
he is to be tried on all the charges in accordance with the
respective laws governing each charge.
Article 7. The Chief Judge and the Investigating Judge
may issue summonses against defendants, witnesses, or complainants;
warrants against defendants or witnesses; detention certificates
against defendants; and search warrants.
Article 8. The Chief Judge is to question defendants
and others, but the attendant Judges may put questions with the
approval of the Chief Judge.
Article 9. At the commencement of a trial, questions are
to be put regarding the name, age, nativity, address, and occu-
pation of the defendant in order to ascertain that he is the
right person to be charged.
Article 10. Defendants are to be questioned separately,
but if it is absolutely necessary, the defendants, witnesses,
or complainants are to be ordered to confront one another.
Article 11. The defendant is to be carefully questioned
regarding all the accusations made against him. If he denies
the charge, he is to be ordered to furnish proof of his
innocence.
Article 12. Before questioning, witnesses or complainants
are to be warned against making false statements and told that
they are liable to punishment if they are found to have given
false evidence. They are to be ordered to sign a bond.

上海临时军法会审审理章程

（刊登于《申报》及其他本地报纸）

第一条 本章程依据《各省临时军法会审组织通则》第七条规定制定。
第二条 上海临时军法会审之审理，须由法官合议进行，出席法官不足半数以上者，不得开庭审理。
第三条 上海临时军法会审不实行律师辩护制度（? 律师辩护）。
第四条 上海临时军法会审之审理不得公开进行。
第五条 案件开庭前，首席法官可指定一名法官进行调查以获取证据；调查结束后，或案情清晰认为无需调查时，调查法官应报告首席法官，以便举行合议庭审。
第六条 发现不属于本庭管辖范围的案件，应移送有关官方机关审理。此外，若被告被控多项罪名，其中一项属于本庭管辖，则应根据各项罪名所适用的相应法律，对所有指控一并审理。
第七条 首席法官及调查法官可对被告、证人或控告人发出传票；对被告或证人发出逮捕令；对被告出具拘留证；以及签发搜查令。
第八条 首席法官负责讯问被告及其他人员，但列席法官经首席法官批准后可进行提问。
第九条 庭审开始时，应就被告的姓名、年龄、籍贯、住址和职业进行提问，以确认其为被指控的正确人选。
第十条 被告应分别接受讯问，但若确有必要，应命令被告、证人或控告人相互对质。
第十一条 应就针对被告的所有指控对其进行仔细讯问。若其否认指控，应命令其提供无罪证明。
第十二条 在讯问证人或控告人之前，应警告其不得作虚假陈述，并告知若被发现提供伪证将受到惩罚。应命令其签署保证书。

- 2 -

Article 13. Court records should be clearly and correctly
made by Court Clerks and read out to the person questioned.
If the person concerned states that a mistake has been made
in the record, a correction is to be made. In the case of
the Court record being correct, the person questioned is to
be ordered to sign his name or affix his finger prints on
the record.
Article 14. Article 9 to 13 are to be applied when an
investigating judge is making enquiries.
Article 15. When the hearing of a case is concluded, the
Chief Judge is to hold a conference of the judges who partici-
pated in the hearing, before rendering a decision. They should
sign their names in the minute book containing the particulars
of the conference.
Article 16. The decision of the conference of the Judges,
put in writing by the Court Clerk and signed and sealed by the
Chief Judge and the Attendent Judges, should be submitted to
the Headquarters of the Woosung-Shanghai Garrison Commissioner for
approval. A report should be submitted to the Municipality of
Greater Shanghai and a notification by letter should be sent to
the Shanghai Special District Kuomintang and the Kiangsu Supreme
Court for their information.
Article 17. If a case is committed by several persons who
are not all in custody, those already arrested are to be tried
and sentenced regardless of the others .
Article 18. If the Headquarters of the Woosung-Shanghai
Garrison Commissioner regards the decision in a case doubtful,
or mistakes have occurred, it may refer the case back to the
Court for retrial.
Article 19. When the decision of a case is approved by the
Headquarters of the Woosung-Shanghai Garrison Commissioner, the
defendant is to be taken before the Court when the Court Clerk
will read out the facts of the case, and the Chief Judge pronounce
the sentence.
Article 20. The Chief Judge is to direct the execution of
the sentences. In the case of the death penalty, the Chief Judge
shall appoint an officer to supervise the execution. No persons,
except those with the permission of the Chief Judge, are to be
admitted to the place of execution.
Article 21. These regulations are to be put into force
after approval by the National Government.

- 2 -

第十三条 法庭书记员应清晰、准确地制作庭审记录，并向被讯问人宣读。若相关人员指出记录有误，应予更正。若庭审记录无误，应命令被讯问人在记录上签名或按指印。
第十四条 调查法官进行调查时，适用第九条至第十三条之规定。
第十五条 案件审理终结后，首席法官应在作出裁决前，召集参与审理的法官举行会议。他们应在记载会议详情的会议记录簿上签名。
第十六条 法官会议的裁决由法庭书记员缮写，并经首席法官及列席法官签名盖章后，提交淞沪警备司令部核准。同时应向大上海市政府提交报告，并以信函形式通知上海特别区党部及江苏高等法院知悉。
第十七条 若案件涉及多人，且并非所有人均在押，则应对已逮捕者进行审理和判决，不论其他涉案人员情况如何。
第十八条 若淞沪警备司令部认为某案裁决存疑或出现错误，可将案件发回本庭重审。
第十九条 当案件裁决获淞沪警备司令部批准后，应将被告带至法庭，由法庭书记员宣读案情事实，并由首席法官宣判。
第二十条 首席法官负责指挥判决的执行。若是死刑案件，首席法官应指派一名军官监督执行。除经首席法官许可者外，任何人不得进入刑场。
第二十一条 本章程经国民政府批准后施行。

MISCELLANEOUS

REGULATIONS GOVERNING TRIALS BY THE SHANGHAI
PROVISIONAL MILITARY AND JUDICIAL JOINT HEARING COURT
( published in the Shen Pao and other local
newspapers)

Article 1. These regulations are
stipulated in accordance with Article 7 of "The
General Principles of Organization of Provisional
Joint Hearing Courts of Military and Judicial Authorities
of Various Provinces."

Article 2. In the Shanghai Provisional
Military and Judicial Joint Hearing Court, trials
are to be held by the Judges sitting jointly, and no
trial is to be held without more than half of the
judges being present.

Article 3. In the Shanghai Provisional
Military and Judicial Joint Hearing Court, the legal
defence system (? defence by lawyers) is not to be
enforced.

Article 4. Trials by the Shanghai
Provisional Military and Judicial Joint Hearing Court
may not be conducted publicly.

Article 5. Before the hearing of a case,
the Chief Judge may designate a judge to conduct an
investigation with a view to obtaining evidence. When
the investigation has been completed or, when the
facts of the case are so clear that an investigation
is considered unnecessary, the investigating Judge
shall then request the Chief Judge to hold a joint
hearing.

Article 6. Cases found to be beyond the
jurisdiction of the Court should be referred to the
official organs concerned for trial. However, if a
defendant is charged with several offences one of which
comes under the jurisdiction of the Court, he is to be
tried on all the charges in accordance with the
respective laws governing each charge.

Article 7. The Chief Judge and the
Investigating Judge may issue summonses against
defendants, witnesses, or complainants; warrants against
defendants or witnesses; detention certificates against
defendants; and search warrants.

Article 8. The Chief Judge is to question
defendants and others, but the attendant Judges may
put questions with the approval of the Chief Judge.

Article 9. At the commencement of a trial,
questions are to be put regarding the name, age,
nativity, address, and occupation of the defendant in
order to ascertain that he is the right person to be
charged.

Article 10. Defendants are to be questioned
separately, but if it is absolutely necessary, the
defendants, witnesses, or complainants are to be ordered
to confront one another.

Article 11. The defendant is to be
carefully questioned regarding all the accusations
made against him. If he denies the charge, he is to
be ordered to furnish proof of his innocence.

Article 12. Before questioning,
witnesses or complainants are to be warned against
making false statements and told that they are liable

杂项

上海临时军法会审法院审判条例
（刊登于《申报》及其他本地报纸）

第一条 本条例依据《各省临时军法会审法院组织通则》第七条规定制定。

第二条 在上海临时军法会审法院，审判由法官合议进行，出席法官不足半数时不得开庭。

第三条 在上海临时军法会审法院，不实行法律辩护制度（？律师辩护）。

第四条 上海临时军法会审法院的审判不得公开进行。

第五条 在案件开庭前，首席法官可指定一名法官进行调查以获取证据。调查结束后，或案情清晰认为无需调查时，调查法官应请求首席法官举行合议庭审。

第六条 发现不属于本法院管辖的案件，应移送有关官署审理。但是，如果被告被指控多项罪名，其中一项属于本法院管辖，则应根据各项罪名各自的适用法律对所有指控进行审判。

第七条 首席法官和调查法官可以对被告、证人或原告发出传票；对被告或证人发出逮捕令；对被告发出拘留证；以及搜查令。

第八条 首席法官负责讯问被告及其他人员，但陪席法官经首席法官批准后可提问。

第九条 庭审开始时，应就被告的姓名、年龄、籍贯、住址和职业进行提问，以确认其为受指控的正确人选。

第十条 被告应分别接受讯问，但如果绝对必要，应命令被告、证人或原告相互对质。

第十一条 应就针对被告的所有指控对其进行仔细讯问。如果其否认指控，应命令其提供无罪证明。

第十二条 在讯问之前，
应警告证人或原告不得作伪证，并告知他们若

evidence. They are to be ordered to sign a bond.

Article 13. Court records should be clearly
and correctly made by Court Clerks and read out to the
persons questioned. If the person concerned states
that a mistake has been made in the record, a correction is
to be made. In the case of the Court record being
correct, the person questioned is to be ordered to sign
his name or affix his finger prints on the record.
Article 14 Articles 9 to 13 are to be
applied when an investigating judge is making enquiries.
Article 15. When the hearing of a case is
concluded, the Chief Judge is to hold a conference of
the Judges who participated in the hearing, before rendering
a decision. They should sign their names in the minute
book containing the particulars of the conference.
Article 16. The decision of the conference
of the Judges, put in writing by the Court Clerk and signed
and sealed by the Chief Judge and the Attendant Judges,
should be submitted to the Headquarters of the Woosung-
Shanghai Garrison Commissioner for approval.
A report should be submitted to the Municipality of
Greater Shanghai and a notification by letter should be
sent to the Shanghai Special District Kuomintang and the
Kiangsu Supreme Court for their information.
Article 17. If a case is committed by several
persons who are not all in custody, those already arrested
are to be tried and sentenced regardless of the others.
Article 18. If the Headquarters of the
Woosung-Shanghai Garrison Commissioner regards the
decision in a case doubtful, or mistakes have occurred,
it may refer the case back to the Court for retrial.
Article 19. When the decision of a case is
approved by the Headquarters of the Woosung-Shanghai
Garrison Commissioner, the defendant is to be taken
before the Court when the Court Clerk will read out the facts
of the case, and the Chief Judge pronounce the sentence.
Article 20. The Chief Judge is to direct the
execution of the sentences. In the case of the death
penalty, the Chief Judge shall appoint an officer to
supervise the execution. No persons, except those
with the permission of the Chief Judge, are to be admitted
to the place of execution.
Article 21. These regulations are to
be put into force after their due approval by the
National Government.

第十八条 如果淞沪警备司令部认为某案裁决存疑或出现错误，可将案件发回本法院重审。

第二十一条 本条例经国民政府正式批准后生效。

REGULATIONS GOVERNING THE FORMATION OF THE SHANGHAI
PROVISIONAL MILITARY AND JUDICIAL JOINT HEARING COURT

The China Times and other local newspapers
publish the following report:-

Article 1. The Shanghai Provisional
Military and Judicial Joint Hearing Court will be
organised by officials appointed by the undermentioned
organs:- (1) the Shanghai Special District Kuomintang,
(2) the Municipality of Greater Shanghai, (3) the
Kiangsu High Court, and (4) the Woosung-Shanghai Garrison
Commissioner's Headquarters. The organ mentioned at
item No.1 (the Shanghai Special District Kuomintang)
may not detail any official to participate in the
organization of this Court.

Article 2. The Shanghai Provisional
Military and Judicial Joint Hearing Court will hear
all communistic cases of an important nature. Cases,
arising in areas wherein martial law is in force or
wherein bandit suppression forces are functioning as
stipulated in Article 7 of the Emergency Penalty Law
for Endangering the Republic after its enforcement,
are not within the jurisdiction of this Court.

Article 3. The organ mentioned at item
No.4 of Article 1 (the Woosung-Shanghai Garrison
Commissioner's Headquarters) will appoint two officials,
while the organs mentioned in other items will each
appoint one official to act as Judges of the Shanghai
Provisional Military and Judicial Joint Hearing Court,
and these deputies will elect from among themselves the
Chief Judge. If the total number of Judges appointed
by the afore-mentioned organs is an even one, the Kiangsu
High Court may appoint an extra Judge.

Article 4. The Shanghai Provisional
Military and Judicial Joint Hearing Court will engage
one secretary-in-chief and a number of assistant secretaries.
These positions may be filled from the staffs of the various
organs mentioned in Article 1, but extra clerks may be
employed.

Article 5. The official seal of the Shanghai
Provisional Military and Judicial Joint Hearing Court will
be issued by the Woosung-Shanghai Garrison Commissioner's
Headquarters.

Article 6. The funds for the Shanghai
Provisional Military and Judicial Joint Hearing Court
will be provided by the Woosung-Shanghai Garrison
Commissioner's Headquarters and the Municipality of
Greater Shanghai.

Article 7. The Regulations governing
Trials by the Shanghai Provisional Military and Judicial
Joint Hearing Court will be issued separately.

Article 8. The detailed rules governing
the functioning of the Shanghai Provisional Military and
Judicial Joint Hearing Court will be drawn up by the
Woosung-Shanghai Garrison Commissioner's Headquarters
in conjunction with the Municipality of Greater Shanghai
and will be submitted to the Administrative Council and
the Judicial Council for approval.

Article 9. These Regulations will come
into force from the date of their approval by the
National Government.

Morning Translation.

SHANGHAI:

NANKING IS URGING THE ABOLITION OF EXTRATERRITORIALITY
and the cancellation of unequal treaties.
To-day will be observed as a general holiday
by the various local Government organs, schools, etc.
- - - - - - - - - -
The Shanghai Special District Association
will bring up a resolution for discussion during the
meeting to be held this morning in the Shanghai Chamber
of Commerce. The resolution is to advise the National
Citizens' Conference to order the National Government to
abolish extraterritoriality and to cancel the unequal
treaties.

EXTRATERRITORIALITY ABOLISHED

The Min Kuo Pao and other local
newspapers publish the following telegram from Nanking:-
On May 4, the National Government
issued the following mandate relating to the abolition
of extraterritoriality:-
The abolition of extraterritoriality
is a determined policy of the government and is
unanimously wished by the Chinese people. All foreigners
residing in China should observe laws and orders
promulgated according to law by the Central Government
or District Governments, and a mandate to this effect
was issued on December 28, 1929. As the Administrative
Council and the Judicial Council have submitted a
petition stating that the regulations for the judicial
control of foreigners have been drafted and duly
examined by the Legislative Council, these regulations
are hereby promulgated and will be put into force
from January 1, 1930.

1931年5月5日。
晨间译文。

上海：

南京敦促废除领事裁判权
并取消不平等条约。
今天，各地政府机关、学校等将普遍放假。
- - - - - - - - - -
上海特区协会将在今天上午于上海总商会举行的会议上提出一项决议供讨论。该决议建议国民会议命令国民政府废除领事裁判权并取消不平等条约。

废除领事裁判权

《民国日报》及其他本地报纸刊登了来自南京的如下电报：——
5月4日，国民政府发布了关于废除领事裁判权的如下命令：——
废除领事裁判权是政府的既定政策，也是全中国人民的一致愿望。所有在华外侨应遵守中央政府或地方政府依法颁布的法律和命令，为此目的的命令已于1929年12月28日发布。鉴于行政院和司法院已提交请愿书，称外国人司法管辖条例草案已由立法院妥善审查，特此颁布该条例，并自1930年1月1日起生效。

C. & S. B. REGISTRY
Extract from the Morning Translation dated
May 7, 1931.

FILE No.

Joint Provisional Military Court, Judges Appointed
SUBJECT.
The China Times and other local newspapers publish
the following report :-

Upon receipt of an order from the National Govern-
ment instructing local Kuomintang, administrative, mili-
tary and judicial organs to form a joint provisional
military court to hear important communistic cases, the
Shanghai Special District Kuomintang, the Municipality
of Greater Shanghai, the Garrison Commissioner's Head-
quarters and the District Court (Nantao) have organized
a preparatory committee and have drawn up regulations
governing court procedure and formation of the court.
These regulations have been submitted to the Administra-
tive Council for approval. The Court was inaugurated
this week and has commenced to function. The following
judges will sit on the bench: Chiang Wai Soo (    ),
member of the local Kuomintang, Huang Dau Chiu (    ),
Chief of the 3rd Department of the Public Safety Bureau
of the Municipality of Greater Shanghai, Kao Teng Ting
(    ), Chief of the Military Department of the
Garrison Commissioner's Headquarters, Chen Han Tsao
(    ) Staff of the Garrison Commissioner's Head-
quarters and Chien Lee Chuia (    ), Judge of the
District Court (Nantao).

It is reported that the communist who was arrested
the other day on a charge of attempted murder of Yang
Fu (    ), Councillor to the National Government,
will be brought before the Court for trial.

Supt. Yan.

联合临时军事法庭，法官任命
主题。
《时报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：——

接到国民政府命令，指示地方国民党、行政、军事及司法机关组建联合临时军事法庭，以审理重要的共产主义案件后，国民党上海特别市党部、大上海市政府、警备司令部和地方法院（南市）已组织筹备委员会，并制定了管辖法庭程序和法庭组成的规章。这些规章已提交行政院批准。法庭已于本周成立并开始运作。以下法官将列席庭审：国民党地方党员蒋维寿（Chiang Wai Soo）(音译)，大上海市政府公安局第三科科长黄道秋（Huang Dau Chiu）(音译)，警备司令部军务处处长高登庭（Kao Teng Ting）(音译)，警备司令部职员陈汉造（Chen Han Tsao）(音译)，以及地方法院（南市）法官钱丽翠（Chien Lee Chuia）(音译)。

据报道，日前因涉嫌谋杀国民政府委员杨虎（Yang Fu）(音译)未遂而被捕的共产党人将被带上法庭受审。

督察长 Yan。
先生。
